checkpoints.quote: BANK-452 is a customer-feedback story requesting that pending card transactions be displayed separately from the displayed balance so users can see their "real available balance". The request is submitted via the public feedback form and currently has no technical specification.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states the customer wants pending transactions shown separately to see their real available balance and that the current display caused confusion.
